setup.fmt2.f3d:
# Wave D geometries showcase: every new primitive in one scene —
# circle, ring, capsule, tube, lathe and extrude, the four Platonic
# solids (icosahedron, octahedron, tetrahedron, dodecahedron) and
# torusknot, each in its own named colour and at its own position
# (top row y=2, bottom row y=-2, spread along x from -8 to 8) so
# nothing overlaps.
# Run: python3 tools/f3dc/f3dc.py run examples/geometries.f3d
scene "geometries" size 800 600 background black
camera at 0 0 18 look 0 0 0 fov 60
light directional dir -0.5 -1 -0.7 strength 1.2
circle radius 1 color red at -8 2 0
ring inner 0.5 outer 1 color orange at -5 2 -1
capsule radius 0.5 height 2 color yellow at -2 2 0
tube radius 0.2 path 0,0,0 1,1,0 2,0,0 color green at 1 1.5 -1
lathe points 0,0 0.6,0.2 0.6,1 0,1.2 color cyan at 5.5 1.5 0
extrude shape 0,0 1,0 1,1 0,1 depth 0.5 color blue at 8 1.5 -1
icosahedron radius 1 color purple at -8 -2 -1
octahedron radius 1 color pink at -5 -2 0
tetrahedron radius 1 color magenta at -2 -2 -1
dodecahedron radius 1 color white at 1 -2 0
torusknot radius 1 color gray at 6 -2 -1
controls orbit
render "geometries.ppm"
